issues.detail: Tul Bahadur Thapa 2025/26: auction report says Kathmandu Gorkhas; performance lists Janakpur Bolts. Price excluded from performance ROI.
User confirmed on 2026-09-23 that UBS Thakuri (fd0aef78) and UB Singh (92493bc9) are separate players. No cross-ID merge. The Thakuri retention record is not assigned to Singh.
Season 1 match results give Kathmandu 4 wins and Biratnagar 2 wins, not 3 each. Secondary published standings agree; match-derived totals are authoritative for this build.

Only explicit roles from the 2025 auction pool are imported. These are 2025-listed roles, including on historical rows; Unknown roles are excluded from role-specific value gaps. All-rounders are not arbitrarily split into batting/bowling types.
Dilip Nath is category A in the pre-auction pool but B in the auction-result report. Acquisition category records the auction result, not the preliminary pool.

User-supplied NPLT20League.com states it is independent and not affiliated with NPL. Its visible 2025 table lists Dev Khanal 128 runs and Aarif Sheikh 39; the supplied ball-by-ball data sums to 127 and 186. These differences are recorded, not silently overwritten. Its auction page corroborates some team assignments but provides no auction prices.

User instructed that retained players have the same price in 2025 as in 2024. Prior exact auction prices are carried to assumed_retained_price_npr, with assumption_source. They are available in an opt-in scenario, separate from verified exact auction outcomes. Marquee compensation remains a minimum, never an exact price.

The pasted 2024 list agrees on the auction amounts but uses A/B/C/D categories, conflicting with the contemporaneous three-category A/B/C report. The reported A/B/C categories are retained; the supplied list is preserved as reference evidence.
